messages:
alice: Kicking off post-deploy verification for deploy/2026-03-21-42 in prod-uswest. Running sequenced probes: kv-prefill -> prefix-warm -> e2e checks. Will report snapshots as they come.

deploy-bot: Deployment finished: id=deploy/2026-03-21-42 commit=5b3f2a3 env=prod-uswest
```
status: success
instances: 24
variant: model-v2-q4_8
start: 2026-03-21T14:02:10Z
```

sasha: Prefill started on edge pool eu1 (staggered wave 1). initial kv-prefill hits look okay, but one host shows slow restore (120s). watching.

ben: quick ask — if prefix hit rate stays <75% after warmup OR p95 jumps >250ms we should pin/rollback. suggest threshold: prefix < 70% OR 5xx rate > 1.5% (5m).

carmen: grabbing telemetry now, sending short dumps. p95 from canary baseline=180ms -> current p95=225ms (prod-uswest). prefix hit rate = 61% (baseline 92%). small spike of 502s from host i-08f... looks correlated with kv restore.

alice: Good catch. Plan: 1) pause ramp to 100% traffic 2) throttle new sessions to 20% 3) pin model variant for traffic >0.5rps to previous stable (model-v1.7.3) until warmup reaches prefix>=85%.

ops-bot: synthetic-run #1423 finished: seq=kv-prefill -> prefix-warm -> e2e. summary: e2e p95=210ms, 5xx=0.9%, prefix-hit=64%. Link: https://telemetry.internal/synth/1423

sasha: reproducing a single-host kv-restore timeline: host i-08f had 2m pause due to volume mount retry, then cache repop started. other hosts warmed in ~30s.

ben: agree with conservative hold. Unless 5xx > 2% or user-impacting errors surface, do NOT rollback automatically. prefer pin + targeted hotfix that can be rolled forward.

alice: Actioning: throttling ramp to 20% now. pin command queued. Will watch next two synth waves (10m).

alice: (command) `deployctl pin --deployment deploy/2026-03-21-42 --version model-v1.7.3 --match "traffic>0.5rps"`

ops-bot: pin applied: model pinned to model-v1.7.3 for routes matching traffic>0.5rps. Auditing ticket: INF-4829

carmen: After throttle: p95 dropped to 198ms, prefix-hit rose to 78% in 6m. still below baseline but trending up.

ben: thumbs-up. We'll keep 20% for a second warmup wave. If prefix-hit >=85% and p95 <=200ms, resume rollout. If not, convene pincall at +30m.

alice: Noted. I'll also open quick runbook note: check volume mount logs on hosts that had long restore, confirm disk health and retry counts.

deploy-bot: Reminder: automated rollback rule suppressed for this deployment until next manual review (reason: sequential prefill warmup in progress).

alice: thanks — will update release notes: add post-deploy warmup caveat and mitigation steps (pin available).

sasha: Will follow up with a minimal patch to reduce mount retry backoff if we see another long restore.

carmen: Next synth wave scheduled in ~6m. I'll post results. :thumbsup:
